tools.name: create_pptx
tools.description: Generate a fixed two-slide PPTX with python-pptx, upload it to the app's APS file scope via reverse-RPC, and return the APS path for the frontend to download.

tools.name: export_pptx
tools.description: Render a deck JSON ({title, subtitle?, slides:[{title, bullets:[str]}]}) into a uniformly styled PPTX with python-pptx, upload it to the app's APS file scope, and return the APS path for the frontend to download.

deck.description: Deck content produced by the LLM and edited by the user.
